name: Yousei Shidou ~Lolita Shoujo no Choukyou Jugyou~
original_name: 幼徒性指導～ロリータ少女の調教授業～
source:
The girls, who start out crying and hating everything you do -- but soon the pain and resistance turns into pleasure and joy...

When the change occurs, thus begins the next part of the training...

And the ending as you reach the end of the training? You'll just have to play and see...

How it goes is all up to the player (main character)!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ035490.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
女孩们一开始会哭泣并讨厌你所做的一切——但很快痛苦和阻力就会变成快乐和喜悦……

当变化发生时，就开始下一部分的训练……

训练结束时的结局是什么？你只需要去玩，然后看看…

至于进展如何，完全取决于玩家（主角）！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ035490.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
